# C# Instructions

These instructions define the coding conventions for C# in this workspace.

## Language Version

C# / .NET 10.0 (nullable enabled, implicit usings enabled)

## Error Handling

Throw typed exceptions; never swallow. Translate at controller boundaries. v2 returns ApiResponse<T>; v1 returns ServiceResponse. Log via LogHelper.

## Naming Conventions

PascalCase for types, methods, properties, public fields, namespaces. camelCase for locals, parameters, private fields. Interfaces prefixed with I. Async methods suffixed with Async.

## Code Organization

Layered architecture: Controllers -> Services -> Repositories -> Storage. Each service has IXxxService interface registered scoped in Program.cs. v2 controllers under Controllers/V2/ return ApiResponse<T>.

## Documentation

XML doc comments on public types and members. Inline <remarks> for non-obvious behavior. ADRs under docs/v5.0.0/adrs/.

## Testing

Tests in tests/AzureNamingTool.UnitTests/ (xunit + Moq + FluentAssertions). UI tests in tests/AzureNamingTool.UiTests/ (Playwright + LightBDD + NUnit, net8.0). AAA pattern. Class name mirrors SUT.

## Dependencies

Manage NuGet packages in src/AzureNamingTool.csproj. Pin to compatible major versions. New transitive deps require ADR justification.

## Safety & Security

<Nullable>enable</Nullable> on; respect annotations. No unsafe code. No reflection-based bypasses. File access resolves within workspace; reject path traversal. ApiKey validation runs before authorized actions.

## Performance

Prefer async/await; never .Result/.Wait(). Use IAsyncEnumerable<T> for streaming. Cache config via CacheHelper. Avoid materializing large LINQ-to-Entities lists.

## Anti-Patterns

The following patterns are prohibited:

Direct file/SQLite access from services; raw data from v2 controllers; hard-coded paths; missing [ApiKey] on new endpoints; catching Exception then re-throwing without context.
